integrity: Complete standalone proof and exact reproducible class enumeration; the conic divisor criterion is mathematical input, not deduced from code.
scientific_limitations: Characteristic at least five and a rational flex required; 19 spectra are group-theoretic and need not each occur over a fixed field. No reconstruction of the curve or its Weil polynomial is claimed. Fermat-cubic specialization is prior research.
title: Two base-field sextactic counts reconstruct the six-torsion configuration zeta functions of a plane cubic
